01 / FROM INFORMATION TO CONTINUITY

Your next decision
has a history.

A customer changes a preference. A team discovers why a process failed. An agent completes a task. The next interaction should start with that understanding.

Remnexa is being built as a memory layer for that continuity: a place for grounded facts, evolving context and reusable experience. Applications get a bounded package of relevant memory with its sources and status attached.

Its foundation already distinguishes what was observed, what someone reported, what was inferred and what was simulated. Those distinctions matter whenever memory influences a decision.

01

Source-aware

Records keep revisions and evidence links. Dependencies can become stale when their foundations change.

02

Time-aware

Business validity and system knowledge are different timelines. Historical context must respect both.

03

Permission-aware

Current namespace and source permissions control recall. A saved memory is never a permanent access grant.

GOOD QUESTIONS

Memory deserves
clear boundaries.

Is Remnexa a hosted memory API today?+

The current foundation is a Python library with a PostgreSQL adapter. A managed API, subscription provisioning and customer API keys are planned delivery work. This site does not issue credentials.

Does forgetting permanently erase a memory?+

Forgetting excludes a memory and its dependent reuse from recall. History is retained. Physical deletion, backup cleanup and model unlearning are separate work and are not claimed here.

Do I need an LLM to store and recall memory?+

The foundation’s normal capture and structured recall path does not call a model. Semantic extraction and autonomous consolidation are not enabled by this package.

Can I integrate it with my own application?+

The intended standalone offering uses the same foundation. Today a pilot needs a trusted composition root and the existing Fabric/Data dependencies. Packaging a supported independent service is part of commercial preparation.
